offering_description.value: Manufactures roofing materials, insulation, and interior and exterior doors for contractors, builders, and homeowners. It supplies these products through building-material distributors, home improvement retailers, and direct sales to commercial customers.

primary_products.value: asphalt shingles; roofing underlayment and accessories; thermal and acoustic insulation; interior and exterior door systems; glass fiber mats

customer_segment.value: B2B: building-material distributors, home improvement retailers, contractors, homebuilders, and industrial insulation buyers; B2C: homeowners buying materials for repairs, renovations, and energy upgrades through retailers

end_markets.value: residential construction; home repair and remodeling; commercial construction; industrial insulation

revenue_model.value: product sales: shingles and roofing accessories, insulation materials, door systems, and glass fiber mats

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: converts asphalt, glass, foam inputs, and door components into building products for distributors, retailers, and builders

geography_served.value: global: primarily the United States and Canada, with operations and sales in Europe and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: roofing systems, building and industrial insulation, interior and exterior doors, and glass fiber mats

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: roofing and building-material distributors, lumberyards, and specialty door dealers; third-party retail: home improvement chains selling to contractors and homeowners; direct sales: major builders and commercial or industrial accounts
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: EPA emissions rules, OSHA workplace safety requirements, and building-code standards for roofing, insulation, and doors

notes: The current scope of the retained glass fiber mat business is uncertain.
